sources: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Saturday statement, via Yeni Safak (Oct 25) and CNN (Oct 25); White House population figures via Reuters/Khaleej Times (Oct 24)
fault_line: Who actually delivered Oleshky — Melania, the Pope, or the generals — and will the mined roads let anyone through?

sections.what_happened: Zelenskyy announced Saturday that Kyiv will abide by the localised Oleshky ceasefire and is relying on American mediation: 'Ukraine will do its part. We count on American mediation to work.' The operation would reopen access to the Russian-occupied Kherson town, deliver food and medicine, and let civilians leave the combat zone. Zelenskyy stressed the binding obstacle: 'In the occupied part, the temporarily occupied part, of our Kherson region, the Russians have mined the roads, making the situation dire, extremely dire.' Both sides confirmed Friday the halt would begin in the early hours of Tuesday Oct 27; the White House earlier said Oct 29 — the date dispute is UNCHANGED and must still be flagged on air. Scope, duration, evacuation destinations and monitoring remain unspecified (Peskov: operation 'certainly' takes at least a few days; Lubinets: 'extremely complex'). This is the LOCAL humanitarian ceasefire for Oleshky only, not a general ceasefire.
sections.what_verified: Primary-source basis: Zelenskyy is the primary source of his own commitment. CNN and Yeni Safak are NOT registry-tiered and therefore do not count toward corroboration; the ceasefire itself was previously confirmed by both sides via Reuters (T1)
sections.what_disputed: Date dispute stands (Oct 27 per Moscow/Kyiv vs Oct 29 per the White House). Public scepticism over attribution persists (UNITED24 comments: many credit Pope Leo XIV, call the Melania framing PR) — an attribution dispute, not a rebuttal of Zelenskyy's commitment. No monitoring or evacuation-destination detail has been published.
sections.why_matters: Kyiv commits: Zelenskyy says Ukraine will do its part — now the mined roads to Oleshky decide whether anyone gets out.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to Oleshky ceasefire (totw-20261025-1000-03) -- Zelenskyy Saturday: Ukraine will honour the local ceasefire and counts on US mediation; mined roads are the binding problem
